# Fiber and gut health

## Target
25 to 30 g a day. Cronometer week 2025-05-11 said I was at 17 g. Oops.

## What I added
- psyllium husk (Metamucil plain, unflavoured), 1 tsp in water at night, up to 2 tsp. Big glass of water or it's a brick
- 2 tbsp ground flax in the overnight oats
- a can of black beans a week, into the bowls
- raspberries (8 g per cup!) instead of bananas sometimes
- whole wheat sourdough from the bakery instead of the white rolls
- fermented stuff: a forkful of sauerkraut with dinner (Dev's batch, see [[Sauerkraut]]) and the kimchi from his friend Jun, who keeps a whole [[Kimchi batch log]]

Went from 17 g to around 28 g over 4 weeks. Too fast at first: bloated and gassy for a week in late May. Slower is better.

## Runner's gut
- 48 hours before the long run or race: low fiber, white rice, white bread, no beans, no flax, no psyllium
- 3 hours between breakfast and a run longer than 20 km
- after the 28 km on 2025-08-23 I had to stop at the Ontario Place porta-potty. Lesson: no raspberries the night before
- race plan in [[Marathon taper]]

## Iron and constipation
Ferrous sulfate made everything grind to a halt in 2024. Switching to bisglycinate plus psyllium fixed it.

## Probiotics
Tried BioK+ for 30 days in June 2025 ($4.49 a bottle, so about $135 total). No difference I could notice. Food is cheaper.
